title: Start Free, Scale When You Need To: Artie’s Free Plan Is Live
summary: Artie Free is a standing $0 plan for real-time database replication, with up to two active pipelines and 1M billable rows per month.
body_markdown:
Artie’s Free plan is live: stream every change from your production database to your warehouse or another database in real time for $0 a month. No credit card or sales call required.


## A plan for wherever you’re starting from


Startups are building products and operating workflows around production data with smaller teams than ever. They want that data in their warehouse – or another database – in real time, but need a way to run a real workload without building and operating Kafka, Debezium, connectors, and monitoring.


That’s why Artie Free exists. Start with one or two real pipelines, using your own databases and destinations, and see how Artie handles your schema and workload. Free is a standing plan, not a trial: stay within the plan’s limits and your pipelines keep running at $0 per month for as long as you want. Scale up when you need more capacity, controls, or support.


## What’s included


- $0 per month, with no expiration date, as long as you are within the plan’s limits.
- Up to 1M billable rows per month. Backfills are included and do not count toward the limit.
- Up to two active pipelines.
- The same included connectors as Growth: Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, and more into Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift, ClickHouse, and more.
- SOC 2 Type II compliance.
- Support through the[Artie Slack community](https://join.slack.com/t/artie-technologies/shared_invite/zt-46jchgb4n-Jf1SMMDVK5SPMPUXbT1Txw) .


Artie Growth is there when you need more than 1M rows per month, unlimited pipelines, proactive monitoring, or controls such as SSO, RBAC, and HIPAA. Moving over keeps your data and workspace exactly where they are.[See the full pricing plans](https://www.artie.com/pricing?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=free_plan) .


## From Growth trial to Free plan, automatically


Every signup starts on a 14-day trial of Artie Growth: up to five pipelines, proactive monitoring, PrivateLink access, and more. The clock starts when your first pipeline deploys, not on the day you sign up, so you can take your time getting set up.


When the trial ends, an account within Free’s limits moves to the Free plan automatically – there is no forced upgrade. An account above those limits is paused, with options to scale down to Free or move to Growth. Either way, your data and workspace stay exactly where they are.


## Start replicating today


[Start free](https://app.artie.com/signup) : no card, no sales call. If you need private networking, HIPAA, or dedicated infrastructure instead,[book a demo](https://www.artie.com/contact) and we’ll walk you through an Enterprise setup.
